+  local config_key="$1" label="flatline_protocol.$1.advisory_voices" tg n rows="" out="" i v _nr=0
+  tg=$(yq eval ".flatline_protocol.${config_key}.advisory_voices | tag" "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
+  [[ -z "$tg" || "$tg" == "!!null" ]] && return 0
+  if [[ "$tg" != "!!seq" ]]; then log "WARN: ${label} is a ${tg#!!}, not a list of aliases — ignored"; return 0; fi
+  n=$(yq eval ".flatline_protocol.${config_key}.advisory_voices | length" "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
+  if [[ ! "$n" =~ ^[0-9]{1,2}$ ]]; then log "WARN: ${label} could not be read or has over 99 entries — ignored"; return 0; fi
+  (( n == 0 )) && return 0
+  rows=$(yq -o=json -I=0 eval ".flatline_protocol.${config_key}.advisory_voices[] | [tag, .]" "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null \
+    | jq -rn '[inputs] | to_entries[]
+        | (.value[0] | if type == "string" and test("\\A[!A-Za-z0-9._/:-]{1,64}\\z") then . else "unreadable" end) as $tg
+        | if $tg == "!!str" and (.value[1] | type) == "string" and (.value[1] | test("\\A[A-Za-z0-9._/:-]{1,128}\\z"))
+          then "\(.key) ok \(.value[1])" else "\(.key) drop \($tg)" end' 2>/dev/null) || rows=""
+  [[ -z "$rows" ]] || _nr=$(grep -c '' <<<"$rows")

+  while read -r i tg v; do
+    [[ -n "$i" ]] || continue
+    if [[ "$tg" == ok ]]; then [[ " $out " == *" $v "* ]] || out+="$v "
+    else log "WARN: ${label}[$i] is not a hop name (${v:-unreadable}) — dropped"; fi
+  done <<<"$rows"
+  printf '%s' "${out% }"
+}

+# --- locality (D-8.1): one classification per hop, from lib/hop-locality.py over the merged catalog + project config ----
+_ADV_LOC_TSV=""       # "<hop>\t<provider>\t<local|hosted>\t<reason>" lines, this process
+_ADV_LOC_REFUSED=""   # "<role>\t<hop>\t<provider>" lines — every hosted hop refused at plan time (the envelope names them)
+_ADV_LOC_KEPT=""      # _adv_locality_filter's answer (a global: the caller runs it at top level, never in $(...))
+_adv_locality_row() { awk -F'\t' -v h="$1" '$1 == h { print; exit }' <<<"$_ADV_LOC_TSV"; }
+_adv_locality_load() {  # <hop>... — classify the hops this process has not classified yet (one python call); fail closed
+  local -a new=(); local h line rows="" cat="${LOA_MODEL_CONFIG:-$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml}"
+  for h in "$@"; do [[ -n "$h" && -z "$(_adv_locality_row "$h")" ]] && new+=("$h"); done
+  (( ${#new[@]} > 0 )) || return 0
+  rows=$(python3 -I "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/hop-locality.py" --catalog "$cat" --config "${CONFIG_FILE:-}" -- "${new[@]}" 2>/dev/null) || rows=""
+  for h in "${new[@]}"; do
+    line=$(awk -F'\t' -v h="$h" '$1 == h && NF >= 4 { print; exit }' <<<"$rows")
+    [[ -n "$line" ]] || line="${h}"$'\t'"unknown"$'\t'"hosted"$'\t'"classifier_unavailable"   # (no answer is a hosted hop)
+    _ADV_LOC_TSV+="${line}"$'\n'
+  done
+}
+_adv_hop_is_local() { _adv_locality_load "$1"; [[ "$(_adv_locality_row "$1" | cut -f3)" == "local" ]]; }
+_adv_locality_filter() {  # <role> <hop>... → _ADV_LOC_KEPT: the local hops in order; each hosted one is refused by name, once per role
+  local role="$1" h p; shift
+  _ADV_LOC_KEPT=""
+  _adv_locality_load "$@"
+  for h in "$@"; do
+    [[ -n "$h" ]] || continue
+    if [[ "$(_adv_locality_row "$h" | cut -f3)" == "local" ]]; then _ADV_LOC_KEPT+="${_ADV_LOC_KEPT:+ }$h"; continue; fi
+    p=$(_adv_locality_row "$h" | cut -f2); p="${p:-unknown}"
+    if ! grep -qxF "${role}"$'\t'"${h}"$'\t'"${p}" <<<"$_ADV_LOC_REFUSED"; then
+      _ADV_LOC_REFUSED+="${role}"$'\t'"${h}"$'\t'"${p}"$'\n'
+      log "locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop $h ($p)"
+    fi
+  done
+  return 0
+}
+_adv_locality_refused_json() {  # → [{role, alias, provider}] for the envelope
+  printf '%s' "$_ADV_LOC_REFUSED" | jq -R -s 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0) | split("\t") | {role: .[0], alias: .[1], provider: .[2]})'
+}
+# The one sentence the config comment and the audit output carry (D-8.1).
+_ADV_LOC_DEGRADED_SENTENCE="locality: local_voices — with one local family the companion is not an independent second voice (duplicate_voice, or not planned), so every security audit is DEGRADED_SECURITY_REVIEW; adversarial-review-gate.sh and verdict-derive.sh treat this envelope exactly as they treat any other."
+
+# --- the budget gate (D-7.4, D-7.6): every planned voice at its catalog price ------------------------------------------
+_ADV_BUDGET_TOTAL=0
+_ADV_BUDGET_VOICES="[]"
+_adv_budget_estimate() {  # <estimated input tokens> <role>=<hop>... → _ADV_BUDGET_TOTAL (cents) and _ADV_BUDGET_VOICES (JSON);
+  # each voice: input tokens × input rate + 2000 output tokens × output rate (micro-USD per Mtok → cents: ÷ 10^10, each term
+  # truncated, as the fixed-rate formula was). An alias with no catalog price falls back to 10 / 30 USD per Mtok and is said;
+  # a zero-priced one estimates 0 and is said too.
+  local tokens="$1"; shift
+  local -a roles=() hops=() args=()
+  local rv rows="" line c_in c_out total=0 voices="[]"
+  for rv in "$@"; do roles+=("${rv%%=*}"); hops+=("${rv#*=}"); args+=(--alias "${rv#*=}"); done
+  if (( ${#hops[@]} > 0 )); then
+    rows=$(PYTHONSAFEPATH=1 PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/adapters" python3 -W ignore::RuntimeWarning -m loa_cheval.metering.pricing \
+      --catalog "${LOA_MODEL_CONFIG:-$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml}" --config "${CONFIG_FILE:-}" "${args[@]}" 2>/dev/null) || rows=""
+  fi
+  local k _bv_role _bv_hop _bv_src _bv_in _bv_out _bv_cents
+  for (( k = 0; k < ${#hops[@]}; k++ )); do
+    _bv_role="${roles[$k]}"; _bv_hop="${hops[$k]}"   # (a role word and a validated hop name — the jq operands below are small)
+    line=$(awk -v a="alias=$_bv_hop" '$1 == a { print; exit }' <<<"$rows")
+    _bv_in=$(sed -n 's/.* input_per_mtok=\([0-9][0-9]*\) .*/\1/p' <<<"$line")
+    _bv_out=$(sed -n 's/.* output_per_mtok=\([0-9][0-9]*\) .*/\1/p' <<<"$line")
+    _bv_src=$(sed -n 's/.* pricing_source=\([a-z_]*\)$/\1/p' <<<"$line")
+    if [[ ! "$_bv_in" =~ ^[0-9]{1,12}$ || ! "$_bv_out" =~ ^[0-9]{1,12}$ || "$_bv_src" == "unknown" || -z "$_bv_src" ]]; then
+      _bv_in=10000000; _bv_out=30000000; _bv_src="fallback"
+      log "budget: no catalog price for $_bv_hop ($_bv_role) — the fixed 10 / 30 USD per Mtok applies to this voice"
+    elif (( _bv_in == 0 && _bv_out == 0 )); then
+      log "budget: $_bv_hop ($_bv_role) is zero-priced in the catalog — estimated 0c"
+    elif [[ "$_bv_src" == "stale_catalog" ]]; then
+      log "budget: $_bv_hop ($_bv_role) has a stale catalog price (price_date older than 90 days) — used as given"
+    fi
+    c_in=$(( tokens * _bv_in / 10000000000 )); c_out=$(( 2000 * _bv_out / 10000000000 )); _bv_cents=$(( c_in + c_out ))
+    total=$(( total + _bv_cents ))
+    voices=$(jq -c --arg r "$_bv_role" --arg h "$_bv_hop" --arg s "$_bv_src" --argjson c "$_bv_cents" --argjson i "$_bv_in" --argjson o "$_bv_out" \
+      '. + [{role: $r, alias: $h, estimated_cents: $c, input_per_mtok: $i, output_per_mtok: $o, pricing_source: $s}]' <<<"$voices")
+  done
+  _ADV_BUDGET_TOTAL="$total"; _ADV_BUDGET_VOICES="$voices"
+  log "budget: estimate ${total}c over ${#hops[@]} planned voice(s) ($(jq -r 'map("\(.role) \(.alias) \(.estimated_cents)c") | join(", ")' <<<"$voices"))"
+}
+
+# --- advisory voices (D-7.4): after the counted voices, concurrently, one wall clock, findings only under advisory_voices[] ---
+_ADV_ADVISORY_PIDS=""   # "pid=token" pairs of the live advisory walkers (the reapers kill only the process forked)
+_adv_reap_advisory() {
+  local e p
+  for e in ${_ADV_ADVISORY_PIDS:-}; do
+    p="${e%%=*}"
+    [[ "$p" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
+    _adv_is_same "$p" "$e" && { _adv_kill_tree "$p" KILL >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
+  done
+  _ADV_ADVISORY_PIDS=""
+  return 0
+}
+_adv_advisory_walk() {  # <voice dir> <type> <sprint id> <timeout> <diff files> <alias> — one advisory voice: the hop, then
+  # process_findings (the same schema, qualification and KF-004 repair rules as a counted voice); its rejected payloads never
+  # land beside the envelope (verdict-derive counts those), and the result is published whole
+  local d="$1" type="$2" sprint_id="$3" timeout="$4" diff_files="$5" alias="$6" raw="" rc=0 res="" st=""
+  export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REJECT_SIDECAR_DISABLE=1
+  export _ADV_SIDECAR_TAG="advisory"
+  raw=$(_adv_invoke_hop "$alias" "$d/system-prompt.txt" "$d/user-prompt.txt" "$alias" "$timeout" "$d/vq-advisory.json" "$type" "$SCRIPT_DIR/../schemas/wire/dissent-${type}.wire.json") || rc=$?
+  printf '%s' "$rc" > "$d/rc"
+  res=$(process_findings "$raw" "$type" "$alias" "$sprint_id" "$rc" "$diff_files") || res=""
+  if [[ -n "$res" ]]; then st=$(_extract_result_status "$res") || st=""; fi
+  [[ -n "$st" ]] || st="malformed_response"
+  printf '%s' "$res" > "$d/result.json.tmp" && mv -f "$d/result.json.tmp" "$d/result.json"
+  printf '%s' "$st" > "$d/status"
+}
+_adv_run_advisory_voices() {  # <type> <sprint id> <timeout> <diff files> <alias>... — every voice started at once under
+  # $CONF_ADVISORY_TIMEOUT seconds of wall clock for all of them; a voice still running then is killed and marked timed_out.
+  # Each voice's files are under $_ADVERSARIAL_WORKDIR/advisory/<n>/
+  local type="$1" sprint_id="$2" timeout="$3" diff_files="$4"; shift 4
+  local root="$_ADVERSARIAL_WORKDIR/advisory" n=0 a d pid tok e deadline alive
+  mkdir -p "$root" 2>/dev/null || return 1
+  for a in "$@"; do
+    n=$((n + 1)); d="$root/$n"
+    mkdir -p "$d" 2>/dev/null || continue
+    printf '%s' "$a" > "$d/alias"
+    if cp -f "$_ADVERSARIAL_WORKDIR/system-prompt.txt" "$_ADVERSARIAL_WORKDIR/user-prompt.txt" "$d/" 2>/dev/null; then
+      ( _adv_advisory_walk "$d" "$type" "$sprint_id" "$timeout" "$diff_files" "$a" ) >"$d/log" 2>&1 &
+      pid=$!
+      tok=$(_adv_fork_token "$pid") || tok=""
+      _ADV_ADVISORY_PIDS+="${pid}=$(_adv_tok_word "$tok") "
+      printf '%s' "$pid" > "$d/pid"
+    else
+      printf 'prompt_copy_failed' > "$d/status"
+    fi
+  done
+  deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + CONF_ADVISORY_TIMEOUT ))
+  while :; do
+    alive=0
+    for e in $_ADV_ADVISORY_PIDS; do _adv_is_same "${e%%=*}" "$e" && { alive=1; break; }; done
+    (( alive )) || break
+    (( $(date +%s) < deadline )) || break
+    sleep 0.2
+  done
+  for (( a = 1; a <= n; a++ )); do
+    d="$root/$a"; [[ -s "$d/pid" ]] || continue
+    pid=$(cat "$d/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)
+    for e in $_ADV_ADVISORY_PIDS; do
+      [[ "${e%%=*}" == "$pid" ]] || continue
+      if _adv_is_same "$pid" "$e"; then
+        : > "$d/timed_out"
+        _adv_kill_tree "$pid" KILL >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+        log "Advisory voice $(cat "$d/alias"): still running at the ${CONF_ADVISORY_TIMEOUT}s advisory wall clock — killed (timed_out)"
+      fi
+      wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
+    done
+  done
+  _ADV_ADVISORY_PIDS=""
+  return 0
+}
+_adv_advisory_block() {  # <type> <counted result json file> <diff file> <alias>…(planned, in order) — the advisory_voices[]
+  # array on stdout: each planned voice's findings (hallucination-filtered, tagged voice: advisory, linked by duplicate_of to a
+  # counted finding with the same file, overlapping lines and the same category) in config order, then every alias locality refused
+  local type="$1" counted="$2" diff_file="$3"; shift 3
+  # (every jq operand below is a small reviewed scalar — a validated alias, a status word, an error cut to 200 characters, a
+  # whole number; the envelopes travel as files)
+  local root="${_ADVERSARIAL_WORKDIR:-}/advisory" _av_n=0 _av_alias d st res entry _av_rc _av_err
+  mkdir -p "$root" 2>/dev/null || return 1
+  local blk="$root/entries.jsonl"; : > "$blk" || return 1
+  for _av_alias in "$@"; do
+    _av_n=$((_av_n + 1)); d="$root/$_av_n"; st=""; res='{}'; _av_err=""
+    if [[ -e "$d/timed_out" ]]; then st="timed_out"
+    elif [[ -s "$d/result.json" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$d/result.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+      res=$(cat "$d/result.json")
+      case "$(cat "$d/status" 2>/dev/null || echo malformed_response)" in
+        malformed_response|api_failure) st="failed"; _av_err=$(jq -r '.metadata.error // .metadata.status // ""' <<<"$res" | LC_ALL=C tr -d '\000-\037\177' | cut -c1-200) ;;
+        *) st="succeeded"; res=$(_apply_hallucination_filter "$res" "$diff_file") ;;
+      esac
+    elif [[ "$(cat "$d/status" 2>/dev/null || true)" == "prompt_copy_failed" ]]; then st="failed"; _av_err="prompt_copy_failed"
+    else st="failed"; _av_err="the voice left no result"
+    fi
+    _av_rc=$(cat "$d/rc" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); [[ "$_av_rc" =~ ^[0-9]{1,3}$ ]] || _av_rc="null"
+    printf '%s' "$res" > "$d/block-in.json"
+    entry=$(jq -c -n --slurpfile cf "$counted" --slurpfile af "$d/block-in.json" --arg a "$_av_alias" --arg st "$st" --arg err "$_av_err" \
+      --argjson rc "$_av_rc" --argjson n "$_av_n" '
+      def anc: (.anchor // "") | if type == "string" then . else "" end;
+      def file: anc | split(":")[0];
+      def lines: ([anc | capture(":(?<a>[0-9]+)(-(?<b>[0-9]+))?$")] | .[0]) as $m
+        | if $m == null then null else ([($m.a | tonumber), (($m.b // $m.a) | tonumber)] | sort) end;
+      def overlaps($x; $y): if $x != null and $y != null then ($x[0] <= $y[1] and $y[0] <= $x[1]) else false end;
+      ($cf[0].findings // []) as $top
+      | ($af[0]) as $r
+      | (if $st == "succeeded" then ($r.findings // []) else [] end) as $fs
+      | {alias: $a, status: $st, counted_as: "advisory_voice",
+         findings: ($fs | to_entries | map(.value as $f
+           | ($f | file) as $ff | ($f | lines) as $fl | ($f | anc) as $fa
+           | ($top | map(select((file) == $ff and $ff != "" and ((.category // "") == ($f.category // ""))
+                                and (if (lines) != null and $fl != null then overlaps(lines; $fl) else (anc) == $fa end)))
+                   | (.[0].id // null)) as $dup
+           | $f + {id: ("DISS-A" + ($n | tostring) + "-" + ((.key + 1) | tostring | if length < 3 then ("000" + .)[-3:] else . end)),
+                   voice: "advisory", answered_by: $a, duplicate_of: $dup})),
+         rejected_count: ($r.metadata.rejected_count // 0), repaired_count: ($r.metadata.repaired_count // 0),
+         rejected_summary: ($r.metadata.rejected_summary // []),
+         cost_usd: ($r.metadata.cost_usd // 0), exit_code: $rc}
+        + (if $err == "" then {} else {error: $err} end)' 2>/dev/null) \
+      || entry=$(jq -cn --arg a "$_av_alias" '{alias: $a, status: "failed", counted_as: "advisory_voice", findings: [], error: "the advisory block could not be built"}')
+    printf '%s\n' "$entry" >> "$blk"
+    log "Advisory voice $_av_alias: $st ($(jq -r '.findings | length' <<<"$entry") finding(s), never counted)"
+  done
+  # the aliases refused by locality, named in the block too (never run)
+  local r_role _av_alias_r _av_prov_r
+  while IFS=$'\t' read -r r_role _av_alias_r _av_prov_r; do
+    [[ "$r_role" == "advisory" && -n "$_av_alias_r" ]] || continue
+    jq -cn --arg a "$_av_alias_r" --arg p "$_av_prov_r" '{alias: $a, status: "refused", counted_as: "advisory_voice", findings: [],
+      error: ("locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop " + $a + " (" + $p + ")")}' >> "$blk"
+  done <<<"$_ADV_LOC_REFUSED"
+  jq -cs '.' "$blk"
+}

main() {
  local type="" sprint_id="" diff_file="" diff_range="" context_file="" model="" budget="" timeout=""
  local dry_run="false" json_output="true" record_fallback="" fallback_reason="" fallback_since="" _rf_given="" _reason_given="" _since_given=""

  # Parse arguments
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --type)       type="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --sprint-id)  sprint_id="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --diff-file)  diff_file="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --diff-range) diff_range="${2:-}"; shift; [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && shift ;;
      --context-file) context_file="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --model)      model="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --budget)     budget="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --timeout)    timeout="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --dry-run)    dry_run="true"; shift ;;
      --json)       json_output="true"; shift ;;
      --record-fallback) record_fallback="${2:-}"; _rf_given=1; shift; [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && shift ;;
      --reason)     fallback_reason="${2:-}"; _reason_given=1; shift; [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && shift ;;
      --since)      fallback_since="${2:-}"; _since_given=1; shift; [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && shift ;;
      *)            error "Unknown option: $1"; exit 2 ;;
    esac
  done

  # Validate required args
  if [[ -z "$type" ]]; then error "Missing --type"; exit 2; fi
  if [[ "$type" != "review" && "$type" != "audit" ]]; then
    error "Invalid --type: $type (must be review or audit)"; exit 2
  fi
  if [[ -z "$sprint_id" ]]; then error "Missing --sprint-id"; exit 2; fi
  # (audit run 1, a5 DISS-C-002: the record-fallback's shape check, before every sink — the id names mktemp's template, the run
  # lock, the move-aside and the envelope's directory, and a path in it walks out of TMPDIR and grimoires/loa/a2a/)
  if ! [[ "$sprint_id" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$ && "$sprint_id" != *..* ]]; then error "invalid --sprint-id (a plain name: [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}, no ..)"; exit 2; fi
  # (thirty-fifth run, a4 DISS-C-002: a flag's presence, never its value, decides — an empty --record-fallback, or a --reason
  # without it, is a usage error, never a dropped value and a full review in place of the record)
  if [[ -n "$_rf_given" && -z "$record_fallback" ]]; then error "--record-fallback needs a status"; exit 2; fi
  if [[ -z "$_rf_given" && -n "$_reason_given" ]]; then error "--reason applies to --record-fallback only"; exit 2; fi
  # (thirty-ninth run, a5 DISS-C-001: the same for --since — an empty one is no "--since not given", which would let the record
  # displace an envelope newer than the aborted run)
  if [[ -n "$_rf_given" && -n "$_since_given" && -z "$fallback_since" ]]; then error "--since needs a timestamp"; exit 2; fi
  if [[ -n "$record_fallback" ]]; then local _rf=0; _adv_record_fallback "$type" "$sprint_id" "$record_fallback" "$fallback_reason" "$fallback_since" || _rf=$?; exit "$_rf"; fi
  if [[ -n "$_since_given" ]]; then error "--since applies to --record-fallback only"; exit 2; fi
  # twenty-fourth run, a2 DISS-C-001: the skills cannot run `date` — a run that dies before it writes any record names its start
  # here, as the --since its `--record-fallback failed` needs
  log "adversarial review run started $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) (if it leaves no record: --record-fallback failed --since <this time>)"
  # twenty-fourth run, b2 DISS-C-001: the script produces the diff itself — a skill granted `git diff *` can pass --output /
  # --no-index; ref names only (never an option), no external diff driver and no textconv
  if [[ -n "$diff_range" ]]; then
    [[ -z "$diff_file" ]] || { error "--diff-file and --diff-range are exclusive"; exit 2; }
    # (twenty-sixth run, a4 DISS-C-003: exactly three dots — a two-dot range diffs the tips, not from the merge base — and no
    # side holds `..`, which no ref name may)
    [[ "$diff_range" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._/~^-]*\.\.\.[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._/~^-]*$ && "${diff_range%%...*}" != *..* \
       && "${diff_range#*...}" != *..* && "$diff_range" != *....* ]] \
      || { error "--diff-range: expected <base>...<head> (ref names only)"; exit 2; }
    # (twenty-sixth run, a4 DISS-C-001: the two runtime failures are refusals a --json caller can read and record, as a workdir's is)
    _ADV_RANGE_DIFF=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/adversarial-range-XXXXXX") || {
      error "cannot create a temp file under ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
      [[ "$json_output" == "true" ]] && _adv_refuse_json workdir_unavailable tmpdir "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
      exit 2; }
    trap 'command rm -f -- "$_ADV_RANGE_DIFF"' EXIT
    # (twenty-seventh run, a4 DISS-C-002: the two sides are resolved once, BEFORE the diff, and the diff is taken between those
    # commits — metadata.scope names what was reviewed, never only a ref name a later commit moves)
    local _rb="" _rh="" _rr="$diff_range"
    if _rb=$(_adv_range_oid "$PROJECT_ROOT" "${diff_range%%...*}") \
       && _rh=$(_adv_range_oid "$PROJECT_ROOT" "${diff_range#*...}") \
       && [[ "$_rb" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}([0-9a-f]{24})?$ && "$_rh" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}([0-9a-f]{24})?$ ]]; then
      _ADV_RANGE_OIDS="$_rb $_rh"; _rr="${_rb}...${_rh}"
    fi
    _adv_range_diff "$PROJECT_ROOT" "$_rr" > "$_ADV_RANGE_DIFF" || {
      error "git diff $diff_range failed"
      [[ "$json_output" == "true" ]] && _adv_refuse_json diff_range_failed range "$diff_range"
      exit 2; }
    diff_file="$_ADV_RANGE_DIFF"
  fi
  if [[ -z "$diff_file" ]]; then error "Missing --diff-file"; exit 2; fi
  if [[ ! -f "$diff_file" ]]; then error "Diff file not found: $diff_file"; exit 2; fi

  # Load config
  load_adversarial_config "$type"

  # Apply argument overrides
  model="${model:-$CONF_MODEL}"
  budget=$(_conf_uint "--budget" "${budget:-$CONF_BUDGET_CENTS}" 0 0)     # (fifteenth run, a1 C-001: the overrides are held to the same shape; a malformed cap is 0 — fail closed)
  timeout=$(_conf_uint "--timeout" "${timeout:-$CONF_TIMEOUT}" "$CONF_TIMEOUT" 1)

  # Check enabled
  if [[ "$CONF_ENABLED" != "true" ]]; then
    log "Adversarial $type review is disabled"
    local disabled_result
    disabled_result=$(jq -n --arg type "$type" --arg sid "$sprint_id" --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
      '{findings: [], metadata: {type: $type, sprint_id: $sid, timestamp: $ts, status: "skipped_by_config", model: null, cost_usd: 0}}')
    # Emit trajectory line so the absence of adversarial output is explainable
    # rather than a silent void. The gate hook does not require the full output
    # file here because config says disabled, but visibility still matters.
    local trajectory_dir="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/trajectory"
    mkdir -p "$trajectory_dir"
    local trajectory_file="$trajectory_dir/adversarial-$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d).jsonl"
    echo "$disabled_result" | jq -c '{
      timestamp: .metadata.timestamp,
      type: .metadata.type,
      model: .metadata.model,
      sprint_id: .metadata.sprint_id,
      status: .metadata.status,
      finding_count: 0,
      cost_usd: 0
    }' >> "$trajectory_file" 2>/dev/null || true
    echo "$disabled_result"
    exit 1
  fi

  log "Starting adversarial $type review for $sprint_id"
  log "Model: $model, Budget: ${budget}c, Timeout: ${timeout}s"

  # Create per-run workdir (concurrency safety)
  # NOTE: workdir must NOT be local — the EXIT trap runs in global scope
  # where local variables are out of scope, causing "unbound variable" with set -u.
  # honours TMPDIR (seventh run, c1 C-005); twelfth run, a3 C-005: mktemp -d — 0700 and unpredictable, so a pre-placed
  # symlink at a guessable `adversarial-<sprint>-<pid>` path cannot redirect the prompts and logs on a shared host

+# tertiary, and so every scorer, since a voice cross-scores the others (no separate judge) — are planned only on a
+# provider whose model entry says `dispatch_group: local` in the merged config (lib/hop-locality.py: the catalog
+# overlaid with this config's hounfour.providers; a local entry whose fallback_chain reaches a hosted one is hosted).
+# A hosted voice is refused by name at plan time, never substituted: a hosted primary or secondary refuses the run (a
+# Flatline review needs both), a hosted tertiary is not planned (2-model mode). The advisor_strategy scorer route
+# (stage_routing.flatline_scorer) resolves its tier inside cheval, not as a declared hop, so it is refused too and the
+# scorers stay on the pinned voices. The red-team pipeline plans its own hops and is refused whole. cheval applies the
+# request-time rules to a local hop and records locality_mode / hop_locality in MODELINV from the same config key.
+_FLATLINE_LOCALITY_RESULT=""   # "" not checked yet · ok · refused (memoised: main and run_phase1 both ask)
+flatline_locality_mode() {  # → hosted | local_voices | invalid:<value>
+    local tg v
+    [[ -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "hosted"; return 0; }
+    tg=$(yq eval '.hounfour.locality | tag' "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "unreadable")
+    case "$tg" in
+        '!!null'|'') echo "hosted" ;;
+        '!!str')
+            v=$(yq eval '.hounfour.locality' "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
+            case "$v" in hosted|local_voices) echo "$v" ;; *) echo "invalid:$(printf '%s' "$v" | LC_ALL=C tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9._-' | cut -c1-40)" ;; esac ;;
+        *) echo "invalid:(a ${tg#!!}, not a string)" ;;
+    esac
+}
+flatline_locality_gate() {  # → 0 when the planned voices are allowed; 1 refused (said). Under local_voices a hosted tertiary

+    case "$_FLATLINE_LOCALITY_RESULT" in ok) return 0 ;; refused) return 1 ;; esac
+    local mode; mode=$(flatline_locality_mode)
+    if [[ "$mode" == hosted ]]; then _FLATLINE_LOCALITY_RESULT=ok; return 0; fi
+    if [[ "$mode" == invalid:* ]]; then
+        error "hounfour.locality='${mode#invalid:}' is neither hosted nor local_voices — no Flatline voice was planned (set hounfour.locality: hosted or local_voices)"
+        _FLATLINE_LOCALITY_RESULT=refused; return 1
+    fi
+    log "locality: local_voices — Flatline voices (and so its scorers) are planned only on dispatch_group: local providers (the Claude Code session model is exempt)"

+    p=$(get_model_primary); s=$(get_model_secondary); t=$(_get_model_tertiary_configured)
+    rows=$(python3 -I "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/hop-locality.py" --catalog "${LOA_MODEL_CONFIG:-$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml}" \

+    for role in primary secondary tertiary; do

+    fi

1	"""Per-provider endpoint policy on the cheval Python path (cycle-129 FR-7, SDD D-7.2, D-8.0).
     2	
     3	The rule, applied at config load to every HTTP provider in the merged ``hounfour.providers`` view:
     4	
     5	* ``allow_insecure_endpoint`` is a host STRING, never a boolean. It must be an IP literal or ``localhost``
     6	  (an insecure endpoint is never resolved through DNS, so there is no rebinding), and the address must be
     7	  loopback (``127.0.0.0/8``, ``::1``) or RFC1918 (``10/8``, ``172.16/12``, ``192.168/16``). Link-local,
     8	  the cloud metadata addresses, unique-local IPv6 and every public range are refused.
     9	* An ``http://`` endpoint is admitted only when its host equals the provider's opt-in host. A mismatched
    10	  host, a public ``http`` host or an ``http`` endpoint without an opt-in fails at load with a named reason.
    11	* Every other endpoint keeps the cycle-099 refusals: ``https`` only, no userinfo, no control bytes or path
    12	  traversal, and no loopback, private, link-local, metadata or otherwise blocked IP literal (``localhost``
    13	  included). One provider's opt-in never changes another provider's checks.
    14	* ``keyless: true`` marks a provider that needs no credential; a literal ``auth: "local"`` is accepted and
    15	  normalised to ``keyless: true`` in the merged view. A keyless provider is admitted only when every model
    16	  declares ``context_window`` and ``dispatch_group``.
    17	
    18	ONE implementation: every URL and opt-in decision here is made by the canonical
    19	``.claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.py`` (the module the bash callers and the health probe use),
    20	loaded by path as ``loa_cheval.codegen.emit_endpoint_validator_ts`` does: ``check_insecure_optin`` for the
    21	opt-in and ``validate_declared_endpoint`` (the full pipeline minus the host allowlist, which an
    22	operator-declared https host is not on) for the endpoint. The refusal codes are therefore the validator's
    23	codes, and URL parsing stays confined to that module (the cycle-099 import guard).
    24	``tests/test_endpoint_validator_optin.py`` runs one case table through both entry points.
    25	
    26	Request-time half (``TransportPolicy`` in ``providers/base.py``): for an opted-in provider, or a model whose
    27	``dispatch_group`` is ``local``, the adapter ignores proxy environment variables, refuses HTTP redirects and
    28	requires every request URL to stay under the declared endpoint path.
    29	
    30	CLI (used by ``model-health-probe.sh --provider <name>``; reads the merged config, never prints a secret)::
    31	
    32	    python3 -m loa_cheval.config.endpoint_policy list-providers [--project-root DIR]
    33	    python3 -m loa_cheval.config.endpoint_policy describe-provider NAME [--project-root DIR]
    34	"""
    35	
    36	from __future__ import annotations
    37	
    38	import argparse
    39	import importlib.util
    40	import json
    41	import re
    42	import sys
    43	import threading
    44	from pathlib import Path
    45	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
    46	
    47	from loa_cheval.types import ConfigError
    48	
    49	# The literal auth values normalised to keyless (D-8.0). Only "local": any other literal could be a real key.
    50	KEYLESS_AUTH_LITERALS = frozenset({"local"})
    51	
    52	# .claude/adapters/loa_cheval/config/endpoint_policy.py → .claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.py

    54	_VALIDATOR: Any = None
    55	_VALIDATOR_LOCK = threading.Lock()
    56	
    57	
    58	def _validator() -> Any:
    59	    """The canonical endpoint-validator module, loaded once by path. A missing
    60	    or unloadable validator is a ConfigError (fail-closed: no endpoint is
    61	    admitted unchecked)."""
    62	    global _VALIDATOR
    63	    with _VALIDATOR_LOCK:
    64	        if _VALIDATOR is not None:
    65	            return _VALIDATOR
    66	        name = "loa_endpoint_validator_canonical"
    67	        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, _VALIDATOR_PATH)
    68	        if spec is None or spec.loader is None or not _VALIDATOR_PATH.is_file():
    69	            raise ConfigError(f"[ENDPOINT-VALIDATOR-MISSING] {_VALIDATOR_PATH} not found; reinstall the framework")
    70	        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    71	        sys.modules[name] = module
    72	        try:
    73	            spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    74	        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — any load failure is fail-closed
    75	            sys.modules.pop(name, None)
    76	            raise ConfigError(f"[ENDPOINT-VALIDATOR-MISSING] {_VALIDATOR_PATH} failed to load: {exc}") from exc

    81	class EndpointPolicyError(ConfigError):

   114

   116	def _is_cli_provider(prov: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:

   126	def normalise_keyless(merged: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:

   141	
   142

   145	    providers = merged.get("providers")
   146	    if not isinstance(providers, dict):
   147	        return
   148	    for name, prov in providers.items():

source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/agy-gate-lib.sh"
# cycle-099 Sprint 1B parity (mirrors red-team-model-adapter.sh): exposes
# `resolve_provider_id` from generated-model-maps.sh so flatline picks up
# new model registry entries (gpt-5.5, gpt-5.5-pro, gemini-3.1-pro-preview,
# etc.) without needing edits to the local MODEL_TO_PROVIDER_ID fallback.
# shellcheck source=lib/model-resolver.sh
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/model-resolver.sh"

# cycle-117 item D (#1177): shared DEGRADED/FAILED trajectory + page helper.
# Soft-sourced — a downstream repo mid-update (lib file absent) must not
# break flatline; the degraded_verdict_maybe_emit call below is itself
# guarded by a declare -F check.
# shellcheck source=lib/degraded-verdict-lib.sh
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/degraded-verdict-lib.sh" 2>/dev/null || true

# Cycle-104 sprint-2 T2.8 (FR-S2.5): voice-drop classifier. Distinguishes
# cheval's CHAIN_EXHAUSTED (exit 12) from other failures so a voice whose
# within-company fallback chain ran to end is DROPPED from consensus
# instead of being treated as a hard failure or silently substituted across
# companies. SDD §6.5.
VOICE_DROP_CLASSIFIER="$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/voice-drop-classifier.sh"

# Note: bootstrap.sh already handles PROJECT_ROOT canonicalization via realpath
TRAJECTORY_DIR=$(get_trajectory_dir)

# cycle-109 Sprint 3 T3.5 (#820 Issue D): source .env / .env.local so
# provider API keys cross into the model-adapter / model-invoke /
# cheval.py subprocess chain. Mirrors the BB pattern at
# .claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/entry.sh (cycle-037 #395).

# .env Trust Model (Issue #898): the legacy `set -a; source .env; set +a`

# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/env-loader.sh"
load_env_file .env
load_env_file .env.local

MODEL_INVOKE="${MODEL_INVOKE:-$SCRIPT_DIR/model-invoke}"

    fi

is_flatline_enabled() {
    local enabled
    enabled=$(read_config '.flatline_protocol.enabled' 'false')
    [[ "$enabled" == "true" ]]
}

get_model_primary() {
    read_config '.flatline_protocol.models.primary' 'opus'
}

get_model_secondary() {
    read_config '.flatline_protocol.models.secondary' 'gpt-5.3-codex'
}

# Provisional resolution — will be replaced by Hounfour router capability
# query when ModelPort interface is available (see loa-finn #31).
# The function signature is the durable contract; the config lookup is temporary.
#
# Checks hounfour config first (canonical), then flatline_protocol.models.tertiary (alias)
# Returns empty string when not configured (2-model mode preserved)
# Cache avoids repeated yq invocations during a single Flatline run
_CACHED_TERTIARY_MODEL=""
_CACHED_TERTIARY_MODEL_SET=false

# cycle-127 FR-1: a tertiary routed to agy (the gemini-headless hop) with hounfour.headless.agy_opt_in not true
# is NOT PLANNED — get_model_tertiary returns empty (2-model mode) and the status reads disabled_by_opt_in.
get_model_tertiary() {
    if [[ "$_CACHED_TERTIARY_MODEL_SET" == true ]]; then
        echo "$_CACHED_TERTIARY_MODEL"
        return
    fi
    local model
    model=$(_get_model_tertiary_configured)
    if [[ -n "$model" ]] && _tertiary_routes_to_agy "$model" && ! _agy_opted_in; then
        model=""
    fi
    _CACHED_TERTIARY_MODEL="$model"
    _CACHED_TERTIARY_MODEL_SET=true
    echo "$model"
}

_get_model_tertiary_configured() {  # the configured tertiary, before the agy opt-in gate
    local model
    model=$(read_config '.hounfour.flatline_tertiary_model' '')
    if [[ -z "$model" ]]; then
        model=$(read_config '.flatline_protocol.models.tertiary' '')
    fi
    echo "$model"
}

_agy_opted_in() {  # true only for a YAML boolean true at hounfour.headless.agy_opt_in (lib/agy-gate-lib.sh; no env override)
    agy_opted_in "$CONFIG_FILE"
}

_tertiary_routes_to_agy() {  # <model> → 0 when cheval would dispatch it through agy (lib/agy-gate-lib.sh routes_to_agy:
    # the gemini-headless hop by name, or a Google model under hounfour.headless.mode cli-only — env wins, as cheval's)
    routes_to_agy "$1" "$(agy_headless_mode "$CONFIG_FILE")" "$CONFIG_FILE"   # (r251-4: project aliases resolved first)
}

tertiary_opt_in_skip_reason() {  # prints the skip line and returns 0 when the configured tertiary is gated off
    local m
    m=$(_get_model_tertiary_configured)
    [[ -n "$m" ]] && _tertiary_routes_to_agy "$m" && ! _agy_opted_in || return 1
    echo "Tertiary model '$m' not planned: disabled by opt-in (the agy route needs hounfour.headless.agy_opt_in: true) — 2-model Flatline, not a degraded voice"
}

get_tertiary_status() {  # active | disabled | disabled_by_opt_in
    if [[ -n "$(get_model_tertiary)" ]]; then echo "active"
    elif tertiary_opt_in_skip_reason >/dev/null; then echo "disabled_by_opt_in"
    else echo "disabled"; fi
}

# cycle-116 D3 (bd-c116-d3-tiering): per-stage tier routing opt-in.
# advisor_strategy.stage_routing.flatline_scorer (default false) governs
# whether score-mode cross-scoring dispatch is routed through the
# advisor_strategy role/skill resolver (cheval.py:1069 role gate) instead
# of the hardcoded --model pin. Default false => byte-identical to today.
# Nested map leaves room for future per-stage keys without a schema churn.
# Cached to avoid a per-score-call yq invocation.
_CACHED_STAGE_ROUTING_SCORER=""
_CACHED_STAGE_ROUTING_SCORER_SET=false
is_stage_routing_scorer_enabled() {
    if [[ "$_CACHED_STAGE_ROUTING_SCORER_SET" == true ]]; then
        [[ "$_CACHED_STAGE_ROUTING_SCORER" == "true" ]]
        return
    fi
    local v
    v=$(read_config '.advisor_strategy.stage_routing.flatline_scorer' 'false')
    _CACHED_STAGE_ROUTING_SCORER="$v"
    _CACHED_STAGE_ROUTING_SCORER_SET=true
    [[ "$v" == "true" ]]
}

get_max_iterations() {
    read_config '.flatline_protocol.max_iterations' '5'
}

# shellcheck shell=bash
# =============================================================================
# tests/unit/adversarial-review-s3-helpers.bash — the whole-run harness shared by the cycle-129 Sprint 3 suites
# (adversarial-review-advisory.bats, -budget.bats, -locality.bats).
#
# main() is sourced and run with `invoke_dissenter` replaced by a stub keyed on the model (canned adapter envelopes + a
# valid single-voice verdict_quality sidecar, the shape the companion suite uses), a temp .loa.config.yaml, a temp
# catalog when a case needs one, no credentials (a keyless host) and the test's own ledgers. No model is ever called.
# =============================================================================

s3_setup() {  # <sprint prefix>
    umask 022
    S3_PREFIX="$1"
    SPRINT="${S3_PREFIX}-$$-${BATS_TEST_NUMBER:-0}"
    : "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:?BATS_TEST_TMPDIR not set — needs bats-core >= 1.4}"
    T="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"
    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
    export PROJECT_ROOT
    OUT_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT"
    [[ ! -e "$OUT_DIR" && ! -L "$OUT_DIR" ]] || { echo "setup: $OUT_DIR already stands" >&2; SPRINT=""; return 1; }
    export LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH="$T/model-invoke.jsonl"
    export LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH="$T/cost-ledger.jsonl"
    export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$T" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$T/xdg-cache"
    export TMPDIR="$T/tmp"; mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
    unset LOA_ADVERSARIAL_KEEP_WORKDIR LOA_ADVERSARIAL_RUN_TAG LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REJECT_SIDECAR_DISABLE \
          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_MODEL LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REAP_GRACE_SECONDS LOA_MODEL_CONFIG LOA_ADVERSARIAL_CLI_HOP_TIMEOUT \
          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_NO_FM_DERIVATION LOA_ADVERSARIAL_RUN_LOCK_GRACE_SECONDS LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_BUDGET_SECONDS \
          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_DISABLE_FALLBACK LOA_ADVERSARIAL_COMPANION_WAIT_SECONDS _ADV_PGREP_BIN _ADV_FLOCK_BIN _ADV_REDACTOR_BIN
    local saved_root="$PROJECT_ROOT" _src
    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib-content.sh"
    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    _src="$(sed 's/^\( *\)main "\$@"$/\1: main disabled for testing/' "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/adversarial-review.sh")"
    grep -q ': main disabled for testing' <<<"$_src" || { echo "setup: the main trailer sed matched nothing" >&2; return 1; }
    eval "$_src"
    PROJECT_ROOT="$saved_root"; export PROJECT_ROOT
    local p v; local -a row
    for p in anthropic openai google; do read -ra row <<<"$(_adv_cred_aliases "$p")"; for v in "${row[@]}"; do unset "$v"; done; done
    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_ENV_DIR="$T/env"; mkdir -p "$LOA_ADVERSARIAL_ENV_DIR"
    if _adv_cred_present anthropic || _adv_cred_present openai; then echo "setup: a credential alias is still present" >&2; return 1; fi
    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_CLI_PROBE=both
    CONFIG_FILE="$T/loa.config.yaml"
    printf 'diff --git a/x.sh b/x.sh\n--- a/x.sh\n+++ b/x.sh\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-a\n+b\n' > "$T/diff.patch"
    CALLS="$T/calls.log"; : > "$CALLS"
    declare -gA BEHAVIOUR=()
    # the repair round-trip is not under test here: every repair is unavailable (the payload stays rejected)
    _repair_finding_via_model() { return 1; }
    invoke_dissenter() {  # <sys> <user> <model> <timeout> <vq_sidecar> <type> [schema]
        local model="$3" sidecar="$5" b sev="ADVISORY"
        [[ "${6:-review}" == "audit" ]] && sev="MEDIUM"   # each gate's own vocabulary — no reject detour
        echo "$model" >> "$CALLS"
        b="${BEHAVIOUR[$model]:-ok}"
        case "$b" in
            ok)
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc --arg m "$model" --arg s "$sev" \
                  '{content: ({findings: [{id: "DISS-001", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:10",
                     description: ("from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"}]} | tojson),
                    tokens_input: 100, tokens_output: 20, cost_usd: 0.0123, latency_ms: 5, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            two)   # one finding that matches the counted one (same file, overlapping lines, same category), one on another line,
                   # one on the same line in another category
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc --arg m "$model" --arg s "$sev" '{content: ({findings: [
                    {id: "DISS-001", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:9-12", description: ("dup from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"},
                    {id: "DISS-002", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:40", description: ("new from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"},
                    {id: "DISS-003", severity: $s, category: "performance", anchor: "x.sh:10", description: ("other category from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"}]} | tojson),
                    tokens_input: 100, tokens_output: 20, cost_usd: 0.002, latency_ms: 5, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            reject)   # a payload the normaliser cannot save (no severity)
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc '{content: "{\"findings\":[{\"title\":\"no severity\",\"category\":\"other\",\"description\":\"Something fails.\"}]}", tokens_input: 5, tokens_output: 5, cost_usd: 0.001, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            fail)  [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" fail ProviderUnavailable 1 > "$sidecar"; return 1 ;;
            malformed) [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"; jq -nc '{content: "not json", tokens_input: 1, tokens_output: 1, cost_usd: 0, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'; return 0 ;;
            slow)  bash -c 'exec -a "$0" sleep 300' "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"; return 0 ;;
            *) echo "stub: no arm for '$b'" >&2; return 99 ;;
        esac
    }
    _s3_vq() {  # <voice> <ok|fail> [reason] [exit]
        if [[ "$2" == ok ]]; then
            jq -nc --arg v "$1" '{status:"APPROVED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:1,voices_succeeded_ids:[$v],voices_dropped:[],chain_health:"ok",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
        else
            jq -nc --arg v "$1" --arg r "$3" --argjson e "$4" '{status:"FAILED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:0,voices_succeeded_ids:[],voices_dropped:[{voice:$v,reason:$r,exit_code:$e,blocker_risk:"unknown"}],chain_health:"exhausted",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
        fi
    }
    export PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/adapters"
}

s3_teardown() {
    pkill -KILL -f "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"'( |$)' 2>/dev/null || true
    [[ -n "${SPRINT:-}" && "$SPRINT" == "${S3_PREFIX:-x}"-* && -n "${PROJECT_ROOT:-}" ]] || return 0
    local d="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT"
    if [[ -d "$d" && ! -L "$d" ]]; then find "$d" -mindepth 1 -delete; rmdir "$d"; fi
    return 0
}

s3_config() {  # <yaml body> → the test's .loa.config.yaml (owner-only)
    printf '%s\n' "$1" > "$CONFIG_FILE"
}

s3_run() {  # <review|audit> → main's stdout (main runs in a subshell: it exits); stderr to $T/stderr.log; the status in $T/rc
    local rc=0
    ( main --type "${1:-review}" --sprint-id "$SPRINT" --diff-file "$T/diff.patch" --json ) 2> "$T/stderr.log" || rc=$?
    printf '%s' "$rc" > "$T/rc"
}

s3_norm() {  # <envelope file> → the envelope without advisory_voices, keys sorted, and only the clock-dependent fields removed
    # (the normalised compare: a timestamp and the repairs' measured wall seconds differ between any two runs, advisory or not)
    jq -S 'del(.advisory_voices) | walk(if type == "object" then del(.timestamp, .ts_utc, .repair_wall_seconds) else . end)' "$1"
}
#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# tests/unit/adversarial-review-budget.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.3 (PRD FR-7 AC-7.5, SDD D-7.4, D-7.6).
#
# The dissent budget pre-check prices every planned voice — the primary, the companion's first hop, each advisory voice —
# at its catalog price (python3 -m loa_cheval.metering.pricing --alias), instead of the fixed 10 / 30 USD per Mtok.
# An alias with no catalog price falls back to 10 / 30 for that voice and is said by name; a zero-priced entry estimates
# zero and is said too. Prices come from fixture entries in the test's project config (hounfour.providers overlays the
# catalog, as cheval merges it). Each voice: input tokens × input rate + 2000 × output rate, micro-USD/Mtok → cents.
# =============================================================================

load adversarial-review-s3-helpers

setup() { export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"; s3_setup sprint-s3bud; }   # (the CLI lock is this test's own — CMP-121)
teardown() { s3_teardown; }

_cfg() {  # <model> <budget> <companion_voice> [extra code_review lines]
    s3_config "hounfour:
  providers:
    openai:
      models:
        fixture-priced:
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 2000000, output_per_mtok: 8000000}
    fixturelocal:
      models:
        fixture-zero:
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
        fixture-stale:
          price_date: \"2000-01-01\"
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 1000000, output_per_mtok: 1000000}
flatline_protocol:
  code_review:
    enabled: true
    model: $1
    budget_cents: $2
    timeout_seconds: 30
    companion_voice: $3
    fallback_chain: []
${4:-}"
}

_big_diff() {  # a diff whose estimate is 1,000,500 input tokens (3,000,000 bytes / 3 + 500)
    { printf 'diff --git a/x.sh b/x.sh\n'; head -c $(( 3000000 - 25 )) /dev/zero | tr '\0' 'a'; } > "$T/diff.patch"
    [ "$(wc -c < "$T/diff.patch")" -eq 3000000 ]
}

@test "BUD-1 the primary is priced at its catalog rate (no fixed-rate fallback): 1,000,500 tokens × 2 + 2000 × 8 USD/Mtok = 201c" {
    _big_diff
    _cfg fixture-priced 150 false
    result=$(s3_run review)
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.status' <<<"$result")" = "budget_exceeded" ]
    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "201" ]
    [ "$(jq -c '[.metadata.estimate_voices[] | {role, alias, estimated_cents, pricing_source}]' <<<"$result")" = '[{"role":"primary","alias":"fixture-priced","estimated_cents":201,"pricing_source":"config"}]' ]
    grep -qF "budget: estimate 201c over 1 planned voice(s) (primary fixture-priced 201c)" "$T/stderr.log"
    ! grep -q "no catalog price" "$T/stderr.log" || { echo "a catalog-priced primary fell back"; return 1; }
    [ ! -s "$CALLS" ]
}

@test "BUD-2 an alias with no catalog price falls back to 10 / 30 USD per Mtok for that voice, said by name (1000c + 6c)" {
    _big_diff
    _cfg mystery-model-x 150 false
    result=$(s3_run review)
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ]
    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "1006" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.estimate_voices[0].pricing_source' <<<"$result")" = "fallback" ]
    grep -qF "budget: no catalog price for mystery-model-x (primary) — the fixed 10 / 30 USD per Mtok applies to this voice" "$T/stderr.log"
    [ "$(grep -c "no catalog price" "$T/stderr.log")" = "1" ]
}

@test "BUD-3 a zero-priced entry estimates 0c and is said: a 0-cent budget admits it, where the fixed rate would refuse" {
    _cfg fixture-zero 0 false
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    grep -qF "budget: fixture-zero (primary) is zero-priced in the catalog — estimated 0c" "$T/stderr.log"
    grep -qF "budget: estimate 0c over 1 planned voice(s) (primary fixture-zero 0c)" "$T/stderr.log"
    grep -qx "fixture-zero" "$CALLS"
    # the same run priced at the fixed rate is refused (the regression this replaces: 2000 output tokens × 30 = 6c > 0)
    _cfg mystery-model-x 0 false
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ]
}

@test "BUD-4 the gate sums every planned voice: primary + the companion's first hop + each advisory voice" {
    _big_diff
    _cfg fixture-priced 1 true "    advisory_voices: [fixture-zero, mystery-model-x]"
    result=$(s3_run review)
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    [ "$(jq -r '[.metadata.estimate_voices[] | "\(.role)=\(.alias)"] | join(" ")' <<<"$result")" = "primary=fixture-priced companion=claude-headless advisory=fixture-zero advisory=mystery-model-x" ]
    # the companion's price is the catalog's (whatever it is today): recompute it from the same CLI
    local row ci co comp
    row=$(PYTHONSAFEPATH=1 PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/adapters" python3 -W ignore::RuntimeWarning -m loa_cheval.metering.pricing --alias claude-headless --config "$CONFIG_FILE")
    ci=$(sed -n 's/.* input_per_mtok=\([0-9]*\) .*/\1/p' <<<"$row"); co=$(sed -n 's/.* output_per_mtok=\([0-9]*\) .*/\1/p' <<<"$row")
    [[ "$ci" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$co" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
    comp=$(( 1000500 * ci / 10000000000 + 2000 * co / 10000000000 ))
    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimate_voices[1].estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "$comp" ]
    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimate_voices[2].estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "0" ]
    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimate_voices[3].estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "1006" ]
    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "$(( 201 + comp + 0 + 1006 ))" ]
    [ "$(jq '[.metadata.estimate_voices[].estimated_cents] | add' <<<"$result")" = "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" ]
    grep -qF "budget: fixture-zero (advisory) is zero-priced in the catalog — estimated 0c" "$T/stderr.log"
    grep -qF "budget: no catalog price for mystery-model-x (advisory)" "$T/stderr.log"
}

@test "BUD-5 a stale catalog price (price_date older than 90 days) is used as given and said" {
    _cfg fixture-stale 1000 false
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    grep -qF "budget: fixture-stale (primary) has a stale catalog price (price_date older than 90 days) — used as given" "$T/stderr.log"
}

@test "BUD-6 with no price CLI answer at all every voice falls back and is said (the gate never prices from nothing)" {
    _cfg fixture-priced 1000 false
    # a PYTHONPATH that cannot import the package: the CLI fails, every planned voice is unknown
    local real patched
    real="$(declare -f _adv_budget_estimate)"
    patched="${real/PYTHONPATH=\"\$PROJECT_ROOT\/.claude\/adapters\"/PYTHONPATH=/nonexistent}"
    [ "$patched" != "$real" ]   # (the seam was found: the CLI really cannot be imported in this run)
    eval "$patched"
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ]
    grep -qF "budget: no catalog price for fixture-priced (primary)" "$T/stderr.log"
}

                jq -nc '{content: "{\"findings\":[{\"title\":\"no severity\",\"category\":\"other\",\"description\":\"Something fails.\"}]}", tokens_input: 5, tokens_output: 5, cost_usd: 0.001, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            fail)  [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" fail ProviderUnavailable 1 > "$sidecar"; return 1 ;;
            malformed) [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"; jq -nc '{content: "not json", tokens_input: 1, tokens_output: 1, cost_usd: 0, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'; return 0 ;;
            slow)  bash -c 'exec -a "$0" sleep 300' "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"; return 0 ;;
            *) echo "stub: no arm for '$b'" >&2; return 99 ;;
        esac
    }
    _s3_vq() {  # <voice> <ok|fail> [reason] [exit]
        if [[ "$2" == ok ]]; then
            jq -nc --arg v "$1" '{status:"APPROVED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:1,voices_succeeded_ids:[$v],voices_dropped:[],chain_health:"ok",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
        else
            jq -nc --arg v "$1" --arg r "$3" --argjson e "$4" '{status:"FAILED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:0,voices_succeeded_ids:[],voices_dropped:[{voice:$v,reason:$r,exit_code:$e,blocker_risk:"unknown"}],chain_health:"exhausted",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
        fi
    }
    export PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/adapters"
}

s3_teardown() {
    pkill -KILL -f "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"'( |$)' 2>/dev/null || true
    [[ -n "${SPRINT:-}" && "$SPRINT" == "${S3_PREFIX:-x}"-* && -n "${PROJECT_ROOT:-}" ]] || return 0
    local d="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT"
    if [[ -d "$d" && ! -L "$d" ]]; then find "$d" -mindepth 1 -delete; rmdir "$d"; fi
    return 0
}

s3_config() {  # <yaml body> → the test's .loa.config.yaml (owner-only)
    printf '%s\n' "$1" > "$CONFIG_FILE"
}

s3_run() {  # <review|audit> → main's stdout (main runs in a subshell: it exits); stderr to $T/stderr.log; the status in $T/rc
    local rc=0
    ( main --type "${1:-review}" --sprint-id "$SPRINT" --diff-file "$T/diff.patch" --json ) 2> "$T/stderr.log" || rc=$?
    printf '%s' "$rc" > "$T/rc"
}

s3_norm() {  # <envelope file> → the envelope without advisory_voices, keys sorted, and only the clock-dependent fields removed
    # (the normalised compare: a timestamp and the repairs' measured wall seconds differ between any two runs, advisory or not)
    jq -S 'del(.advisory_voices) | walk(if type == "object" then del(.timestamp, .ts_utc, .repair_wall_seconds) else . end)' "$1"
}

# =============================================================================
# tests/unit/adversarial-review-budget.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.3 (PRD FR-7 AC-7.5, SDD D-7.4, D-7.6).
#
# The dissent budget pre-check prices every planned voice — the primary, the companion's first hop, each advisory voice —
# at its catalog price (python3 -m loa_cheval.metering.pricing --alias), instead of the fixed 10 / 30 USD per Mtok.
# An alias with no catalog price falls back to 10 / 30 for that voice and is said by name; a zero-priced entry estimates
# zero and is said too. Prices come from fixture entries in the test's project config (hounfour.providers overlays the
# catalog, as cheval merges it). Each voice: input tokens × input rate + 2000 × output rate, micro-USD/Mtok → cents.
# =============================================================================

load adversarial-review-s3-helpers

setup() { export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"; s3_setup sprint-s3bud; }   # (the CLI lock is this test's own — CMP-121)
teardown() { s3_teardown; }

_cfg() {  # <model> <budget> <companion_voice> [extra code_review lines]
    s3_config "hounfour:
  providers:
    openai:
      models:
        fixture-priced:
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 2000000, output_per_mtok: 8000000}
    fixturelocal:
      models:
        fixture-zero:
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
        fixture-stale:
          price_date: \"2000-01-01\"
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 1000000, output_per_mtok: 1000000}
flatline_protocol:
  code_review:
    enabled: true

    budget_cents: $2

${4:-}"

_big_diff() {  # a diff whose estimate is 1,000,500 input tokens (3,000,000 bytes / 3 + 500)
    { printf 'diff --git a/x.sh b/x.sh\n'; head -c $(( 3000000 - 25 )) /dev/zero | tr '\0' 'a'; } > "$T/diff.patch"
    [ "$(wc -c < "$T/diff.patch")" -eq 3000000 ]
}

@test "BUD-1 the primary is priced at its catalog rate (no fixed-rate fallback): 1,000,500 tokens × 2 + 2000 × 8 USD/Mtok = 201c" {
    _big_diff
    _cfg fixture-priced 150 false
    result=$(s3_run review)
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.status' <<<"$result")" = "budget_exceeded" ]
    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "201" ]
    [ "$(jq -c '[.metadata.estimate_voices[] | {role, alias, estimated_cents, pricing_source}]' <<<"$result")" = '[{"role":"primary","alias":"fixture-priced","estimated_cents":201,"pricing_source":"config"}]' ]
    grep -qF "budget: estimate 201c over 1 planned voice(s) (primary fixture-priced 201c)" "$T/stderr.log"
    ! grep -q "no catalog price" "$T/stderr.log" || { echo "a catalog-priced primary fell back"; return 1; }
    [ ! -s "$CALLS" ]
}

@test "BUD-2 an alias with no catalog price falls back to 10 / 30 USD per Mtok for that voice, said by name (1000c + 6c)" {
    _big_diff
    _cfg mystery-model-x 150 false
    result=$(s3_run review)
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ]
    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "1006" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.estimate_voices[0].pricing_source' <<<"$result")" = "fallback" ]
    grep -qF "budget: no catalog price for mystery-model-x (primary) — the fixed 10 / 30 USD per Mtok applies to this voice" "$T/stderr.log"
    [ "$(grep -c "no catalog price" "$T/stderr.log")" = "1" ]
}

@test "BUD-3 a zero-priced entry estimates 0c and is said: a 0-cent budget admits it, where the fixed rate would refuse" {
    _cfg fixture-zero 0 false
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    grep -qF "budget: fixture-zero (primary) is zero-priced in the catalog — estimated 0c" "$T/stderr.log"
    grep -qF "budget: estimate 0c over 1 planned voice(s) (primary fixture-zero 0c)" "$T/stderr.log"
    grep -qx "fixture-zero" "$CALLS"

    _cfg mystery-model-x 0 false

    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ]
}

@test "BUD-4 the gate sums every planned voice: primary + the companion's first hop + each advisory voice" {
    _big_diff
    _cfg fixture-priced 1 true "    advisory_voices: [fixture-zero, mystery-model-x]"
    result=$(s3_run review)
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    [ "$(jq -r '[.metadata.estimate_voices[] | "\(.role)=\(.alias)"] | join(" ")' <<<"$result")" = "primary=fixture-priced companion=claude-headless advisory=fixture-zero advisory=mystery-model-x" ]
    # the companion's price is the catalog's (whatever it is today): recompute it from the same CLI
    local row ci co comp
    row=$(PYTHONSAFEPATH=1 PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/adapters" python3 -W ignore::RuntimeWarning -m loa_cheval.metering.pricing --alias claude-headless --config "$CONFIG_FILE")
    ci=$(sed -n 's/.* input_per_mtok=\([0-9]*\) .*/\1/p' <<<"$row"); co=$(sed -n 's/.* output_per_mtok=\([0-9]*\) .*/\1/p' <<<"$row")
    [[ "$ci" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$co" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
    comp=$(( 1000500 * ci / 10000000000 + 2000 * co / 10000000000 ))
    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimate_voices[1].estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "$comp" ]
    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimate_voices[2].estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "0" ]
    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimate_voices[3].estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "1006" ]
    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "$(( 201 + comp + 0 + 1006 ))" ]
    [ "$(jq '[.metadata.estimate_voices[].estimated_cents] | add' <<<"$result")" = "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" ]

    grep -qF "budget: no catalog price for mystery-model-x (advisory)" "$T/stderr.log"
}

@test "BUD-5 a stale catalog price (price_date older than 90 days) is used as given and said" {
    _cfg fixture-stale 1000 false
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# tests/unit/adversarial-review-locality.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.5 (PRD FR-8 AC-8.1 … AC-8.3, SDD D-8.0 … D-8.2,
# DEC-0146).
#
# Under hounfour.locality: local_voices, adversarial-review.sh plans only hops whose provider has dispatch_group: local in
# the merged config (catalog + the project's hounfour.providers) and refuses every hosted hop of its inventory at plan time
# by name — primary chain, companion chain, advisory voices, the KF-004 repair chain (tiny, claude-headless, any pin; the
# chain is the answering voice). With one local family the audit is DEGRADED_SECURITY_REVIEW, the gate and verdict-derive
# treat the envelope as today, and the output says so. The default (hosted) is unchanged. Mock mode: the harness stub.
# =============================================================================

load adversarial-review-s3-helpers

setup() { export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"; s3_setup sprint-s3loc; }   # (the CLI lock is this test's own — CMP-121)
teardown() { s3_teardown; }

# one hosted provider (openai, the catalog's) and one local provider (localbox, declared here)
_cfg() {  # <locality value | absent> [extra code_review / security_audit lines]
    local loc=""; [[ "$1" == absent ]] || loc="  locality: $1"
    s3_config "hounfour:
$loc
  providers:
    localbox:
      type: openai_compat
      endpoint: \"http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1\"
      models:
        qwen-local:
          dispatch_group: local
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
        qwen-local-b:
          dispatch_group: local
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
        qwen-local-c:
          dispatch_group: local
        qwen-leaky:
          dispatch_group: local
          fallback_chain: [\"openai:gpt-5.5\"]
  aliases:
    lq: \"localbox:qwen-local\"
    lqb: \"localbox:qwen-local-b\"
    lqc: \"localbox:qwen-local-c\"
flatline_protocol:
  code_review:
    enabled: true
    model: gpt-5.5
    budget_cents: 500
    timeout_seconds: 30
    fallback_chain: [lq]
${2:-}
  security_audit:
    enabled: true
    model: gpt-5.5
    budget_cents: 500
    timeout_seconds: 30
    fallback_chain: [lq]
${3:-}"
}

_hosted_in() {  # <file of hop names, one per line> → the hosted ones, as hop-locality.py classifies them against this config
    local hops; hops=$(sed 's/^repair://' "$1" | sort -u | grep -v '^$' || true)
    [[ -n "$hops" ]] || return 0
    # shellcheck disable=SC2086
    python3 -I "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/hop-locality.py" --catalog "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" \
        --config "$CONFIG_FILE" -- $hops | awk -F'\t' '$3 != "local" { print $1 }'
}

@test "LOC-1 one hosted and one local provider: only the local hop is planned and every hosted hop is refused by name" {
    _cfg local_voices
    result=$(s3_run review)
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    env="$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json"
    # the dispatched hops: the local one only
    [ "$(sort -u "$CALLS" | tr '\n' ' ')" = "lq " ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.final_model' "$env")" = "lq" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.model_attempts | join(",")' "$env")" = "lq:reviewed" ]
    # each refusal named: the hosted primary, the companion's default hop, the repair chain's two hosted hops
    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop gpt-5.5 (openai)" "$T/stderr.log"
    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop claude-headless (anthropic)" "$T/stderr.log"
    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop tiny (anthropic)" "$T/stderr.log"
    # the companion was not planned: its chain had no local hop — never rerouted
    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.companion_voice.planned' "$env")" = "false" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.companion_voice.reason' "$env")" = "locality_refused" ]
    # the envelope names the posture and each refusal with its role
    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.locality.mode' "$env")" = "local_voices" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '[.metadata.locality.refused[] | "\(.role):\(.alias):\(.provider)"] | sort | join(" ")' "$env")" = \
      "companion:claude-headless:anthropic primary:gpt-5.5:openai repair:claude-headless:anthropic repair:tiny:anthropic" ]
    [ "$(jq '.verdict_quality.voices_planned' "$env")" = "1" ]
}

@test "LOC-2 the repair chain is pinned to the answering local voice: no tiny, no claude-headless, no pin — even with an Anthropic key" {
    _cfg local_voices
    export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="fixture-not-a-key"   # (tiny would lead the hosted chain with a key present)
    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_MODEL="tiny claude-headless"
    load_adversarial_config review
    [ "$CONF_LOCALITY" = "local_voices" ]
    [ "$(_repair_model_chain lq)" = "lq" ]
    [ "$(_repair_chain_base lq)" = "lq" ]
    [ "$(_repair_model_chain gpt-5.5)" = "" ]   # (a hosted answering voice gets no repair hop at all)
    # and under hosted the same host walks tiny first (the switch is what pins it)
    _cfg hosted
    load_adversarial_config review
    [ "$(_repair_model_chain lq)" = "tiny claude-headless" ]   # (the operator pin is the whole chain under hosted)
    unset LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_MODEL
    [ "$(_repair_model_chain lq)" = "tiny claude-headless lq" ]
}

@test "LOC-3 redaction-style: in a whole run with a rejected payload, an Anthropic key and the CLIs present, no hosted alias is ever dispatched" {
    _cfg local_voices "    advisory_voices: [lqc, gpt-5.5-pro]
    companion_chain:

    export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="fixture-not-a-key" OPENAI_API_KEY="fixture-not-a-key"

    BEHAVIOUR[lq]=reject

    local planned

    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop gpt-5.5-pro (openai)" "$T/stderr.log"
    # the refused advisory voice is named in the block, never run
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[] | select(.alias == "gpt-5.5-pro") | .status' "$env")" = "refused" ]

}

@test "LOC-4 one local family on the audit gate: the companion is duplicate_voice, the DEGRADED sentence is in the output, and the gate and verdict-derive treat the envelope as today" {
    _cfg local_voices "" "    companion_chain:

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# tests/unit/adversarial-review-locality.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.5 (PRD FR-8 AC-8.1 … AC-8.3, SDD D-8.0 … D-8.2,
# DEC-0146).
#
# Under hounfour.locality: local_voices, adversarial-review.sh plans only hops whose provider has dispatch_group: local in
# the merged config (catalog + the project's hounfour.providers) and refuses every hosted hop of its inventory at plan time
# by name — primary chain, companion chain, advisory voices, the KF-004 repair chain (tiny, claude-headless, any pin; the
# chain is the answering voice). With one local family the audit is DEGRADED_SECURITY_REVIEW, the gate and verdict-derive
# treat the envelope as today, and the output says so. The default (hosted) is unchanged. Mock mode: the harness stub.
# =============================================================================

load adversarial-review-s3-helpers

setup() { export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"; s3_setup sprint-s3loc; }   # (the CLI lock is this test's own — CMP-121)
teardown() { s3_teardown; }

# one hosted provider (openai, the catalog's) and one local provider (localbox, declared here)
_cfg() {  # <locality value | absent> [extra code_review / security_audit lines]
    local loc=""; [[ "$1" == absent ]] || loc="  locality: $1"
    s3_config "hounfour:
$loc
  providers:
    localbox:
      type: openai_compat
      endpoint: \"http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1\"
      models:
        qwen-local:
          dispatch_group: local
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
        qwen-local-b:
          dispatch_group: local
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
        qwen-local-c:
          dispatch_group: local
        qwen-leaky:
          dispatch_group: local
          fallback_chain: [\"openai:gpt-5.5\"]
  aliases:
    lq: \"localbox:qwen-local\"
    lqb: \"localbox:qwen-local-b\"
    lqc: \"localbox:qwen-local-c\"
flatline_protocol:
  code_review:
    enabled: true
    model: gpt-5.5
    budget_cents: 500
    timeout_seconds: 30
    fallback_chain: [lq]
${2:-}
  security_audit:
    enabled: true
    model: gpt-5.5
    budget_cents: 500
    timeout_seconds: 30
    fallback_chain: [lq]
${3:-}"
}

_hosted_in() {  # <file of hop names, one per line> → the hosted ones, as hop-locality.py classifies them against this config
    local hops; hops=$(sed 's/^repair://' "$1" | sort -u | grep -v '^$' || true)
    [[ -n "$hops" ]] || return 0
    # shellcheck disable=SC2086
    python3 -I "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/hop-locality.py" --catalog "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" \
        --config "$CONFIG_FILE" -- $hops | awk -F'\t' '$3 != "local" { print $1 }'
}

     3	SDD D-8.0 / D-8.1, DEC-0146).
     4	
     5	    python3 -I hop-locality.py --catalog <model-config.yaml> --config <.loa.config.yaml> -- <hop>...
     6	
     7	One tab-separated line per hop, in the order given:
     8	
     9	    <hop> TAB <provider|unknown> TAB <local|hosted> TAB <reason>
    10	
    11	A hop is `local` only when ALL of these hold in the merged view (the System Zone catalog overlaid with the project
    12	config's `hounfour.providers` / `hounfour.aliases`, the two layers cheval merges):
    13	  * it resolves (a `provider:id` pin, an alias chain, or a bare id that exactly one provider declares) to a model entry
    14	    that exists;
    15	  * that model entry, or its provider block, says `dispatch_group: local` (the canonical key, D-8.0);
    16	  * every hop on the entry's own `fallback_chain` is local by the same rule — cheval walks that chain inside one call,
    17	    so a local entry that falls back to a hosted one would leave the declared providers without the planner seeing it.
    18	Everything else is `hosted`: an unresolved hop, an unreadable config, a headless CLI hop (its dispatch group is the
    19	provider family's), the native session. Fail closed — a hop is never called local because it could not be read.
    20	
    21	This file reads declarations only: it never dispatches, never reads credentials and never imports the cheval package
    22	(run under `-I`, so neither the cwd nor PYTHONPATH reaches sys.path). The request-time rules for a local hop (IP-literal
    23	or localhost endpoint, no DNS, redirects refused, proxy env ignored, destination logged) are cheval's.
    24	"""
    25	from __future__ import annotations
    26	
    27	import argparse
    28	import sys
    29	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
    30	
    31	MAX_DEPTH = 10
    32	
    33	
    34	def _merge(base: Any, overlay: Any) -> Any:
    35	    if isinstance(base, dict) and isinstance(overlay, dict):
    36	        out = dict(base)
    37	        for key, value in overlay.items():
    38	            out[key] = _merge(base.get(key), value) if key in base else value
    39	        return out
    40	    return overlay
    41	
    42	
    43	def load_merged(catalog_path: str, config_path: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    44	    import yaml
    45	
    46	    with open(catalog_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    47	        catalog = yaml.safe_load(fh) or {}
    48	    if not isinstance(catalog, dict):
    49	        raise ValueError("catalog is not a mapping")
    50	    merged: Dict[str, Any] = {k: (catalog.get(k) if isinstance(catalog.get(k), dict) else {})
    51	                              for k in ("providers", "aliases", "backward_compat_aliases")}
    52	    if config_path:
    53	        try:
    54	            with open(config_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    55	                project = yaml.safe_load(fh) or {}
    56	        except FileNotFoundError:
    57	            project = {}
    58	        if not isinstance(project, dict):
    59	            raise ValueError("project config is not a mapping")
    60	        hounfour = project.get("hounfour")
    61	        if isinstance(hounfour, dict):
    62	            for key in ("providers", "aliases"):
    63	                if isinstance(hounfour.get(key), dict):
    64	                    merged[key] = _merge(merged.get(key) or {}, hounfour[key])
    65	    return merged
    66	
    67	
    68	def _alias_target(name: str, merged: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[str]:
    69	    for table in ("aliases", "backward_compat_aliases"):
    70	        target = (merged.get(table) or {}).get(name)
    71	        if isinstance(target, dict):
    72	            target = target.get("target") or target.get("model")
    73	        if isinstance(target, str) and target.strip():
    74	            return target.strip()
    75	    return None
    76	
    77	
    78	def resolve(hop: str, merged: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str]]:
    79	    name = (hop or "").strip()
    80	    if not name:
    81	        return None
    82	    current, seen = name, set()
    83	    for _ in range(MAX_DEPTH):
    84	        if ":" in current:
    85	            provider, _, model = current.partition(":")
    86	            return (provider, model) if provider and model else None
    87	        target = _alias_target(current, merged)
    88	        if not target:
    89	            break
    90	        if target in seen:
    91	            return None
    92	        seen.add(current)
    93	        current = target
    94	    if ":" in current:
    95	        provider, _, model = current.partition(":")
    96	        return (provider, model) if provider and model else None
    97	    providers = merged.get("providers") or {}
    98	    matches = [p for p, block in providers.items()
    99	               if isinstance(block, dict) and isinstance(block.get("models"), dict) and current in block["models"]]
   100	    return (matches[0], current) if len(matches) == 1 else None
   101	
   102	
   103	def classify(hop: str, merged: Dict[str, Any], _depth: int = 0, _seen: Optional[set] = None) -> Tuple[str, str, str]:
   104	    """(provider, locality, reason) for one hop."""
   105	    seen = set(_seen or ())
   106	    target = resolve(hop, merged)
   107	    if target is None:
   108	        return "unknown", "hosted", "unresolved"
   109	    provider, model = target
   110	    block = (merged.get("providers") or {}).get(provider)
   111	    if not isinstance(block, dict):
   112	        return provider, "hosted", "provider_not_declared"
   113	    entry = (block.get("models") or {}).get(model) if isinstance(block.get("models"), dict) else None
   114	    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   115	        return provider, "hosted", "model_not_declared"
   116	    group = entry.get("dispatch_group") or block.get("dispatch_group") or ""
   117	    if group != "local":
   118	        return provider, "hosted", f"dispatch_group={group or 'unset'}"
   119	    key = f"{provider}:{model}"
   120	    if key in seen:
   121	        return provider, "local", "dispatch_group=local"
   122	    seen.add(key)
   123	    chain = entry.get("fallback_chain") or []
   124	    if not isinstance(chain, list):
   125	        return provider, "hosted", "fallback_chain_unreadable"
   126	    if _depth >= MAX_DEPTH:
   127	        return provider, "hosted", "fallback_chain_too_deep"
   128	    for nxt in chain:
   129	        if not isinstance(nxt, str):
   130	            return provider, "hosted", "fallback_chain_unreadable"
   131	        p2, loc, _ = classify(nxt, merged, _depth + 1, seen)
   132	        if loc != "local":
   133	            return provider, "hosted", f"fallback_chain_reaches_hosted:{nxt}({p2})"
   134	    return provider, "local", "dispatch_group=local"
   135	
   136	
   137	def _clean(text: str) -> str:
   138	    return "".join(c if c.isprintable() and c not in "\t" else "_" for c in text)[:128]
   139	
   140	
   141	def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
   142	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
   143	    ap.add_argument("--catalog", required=True)
   144	    ap.add_argument("--config", default="")
   145	    ap.add_argument("hops", nargs="*")
   146	    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
   147	    try:
   148	        merged = load_merged(args.catalog, args.config or None)
   149	        err = ""
   150	    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — fail closed: every hop hosted, the reason said once
   151	        merged, err = None, f"{type(exc).__name__}"
   152	        print(f"hop-locality: the merged config could not be read ({err}) — every hop is hosted", file=sys.stderr)
   153	    for hop in args.hops:
   154	        if merged is None:
   155	            print(f"{_clean(hop)}\tunknown\thosted\tconfig_unreadable")
   156	            continue
   157	        provider, loc, reason = classify(hop, merged)
   158	        print(f"{_clean(hop)}\t{_clean(provider)}\t{loc}\t{_clean(reason)}")
   159	    return 0
   160	
   161	
   162	if __name__ == "__main__":
   163	    raise SystemExit(main())
